# Logging (cms-api)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: none yet.

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

What a use case may log (`warn`, `error`) without depending on Nest. The module is global, so any provider can inject `APP_LOGGER`.

## Techniques

Port plus one adapter on the Nest `Logger`, so output keeps the Nest format. Callers log names and codes, never secrets or values ([global rules](../../global/RULES.md)).

## Technologies

NestJS `Logger`.

## Entry points

`APP_LOGGER`, `AppLogger`, `LoggingModule` (global).

## Where to change what

Another log level or sink: extend `AppLogger.port.ts` and the adapter together; keep the port free of Nest types.
